reference.paper: Neural Robot Dynamics, arXiv:2508.15755v1, Appendix C.4
reference.our_length_convention: 100 transitions and 101 stored states per trajectory
reference.scope: Unactuated random initial-state cube tossing. Matches the synthetic pretraining count, not exact NeRD sampling ranges, solver, geometry or real data. OOD uses 500 wall-directed tosses above a flat floor and 500 train-distribution tosses onto a two-plane valley, each plane tilted 10 degrees. Existing generated training data are unchanged; use cube_toss_ood_v2.json to regenerate OOD only.
